examples.description: Reject a claim with a reason

failure_modes.recovery: Ask a tenant admin or owner to reject.
failure_modes.when: the caller's role is below admin

failure_modes.recovery: Only submitted (pending) expenses can be rejected.

preconditions: id is required; rejection_reason (≤500 chars) is optional but kind. pending → rejected (admin+).

description: Rejects a submitted expense claim — requires the admin or owner role, and only a 'pending' expense qualifies (CONFLICT otherwise). rejection_reason (up to 500 chars) is optional but records why; rejected is terminal and never counts as spend, so a corrected claim is a fresh expense_create, never a resubmit.
name: expense_reject
